transcript.text: Thanks everyone. Before we proceed with the launch review, I need to state our engineering operational constraint: the triage worker's connection pool can only safely handle up to 2 concurrent inference requests. If concurrency exceeds 2, the pool exhausts, requests time out, and those tickets bypass the manual-review fallback entirely — leaving them without a routing label. Our constraint is that the rollout configuration must cap concurrency at 2. The good news is this can be handled entirely in the rollout config, so no separate engineering deployment is needed before flag enablement next Tuesday.
